presentation.title: Real-time collaboration — Dimentionalizer
presentation.headline: Real-time collaboration.
presentation.description: Two real-time servers share durable messages and fan-out work while clients keep WebSocket connections. Includes presence, attachments, and offline notifications.

objects.name: Web client
objects.description: Maintains an authenticated WebSocket session and displays shared updates.

objects.name: Mobile client
objects.description: Connects to the same collaboration service and reconnects after interruptions.

objects.name: WebSocket ingress
objects.description: Routes long-lived connections to real-time service instances.

objects.name: Realtime server A
objects.description: Validates sessions, persists messages, and publishes fan-out work.

objects.name: Realtime server B
objects.description: A second real-time instance serving a different set of active connections.

objects.name: Presence cache
objects.description: Stores expiring presence and connection ownership. Presence is ephemeral, not an authoritative user record.

objects.name: Message database
objects.description: Stores durable messages and cursor positions so clients can catch up.

objects.name: Attachment storage
objects.description: Stores shared files with authorization on uploads and downloads.

objects.name: Fan-out dispatcher
objects.description: Routes committed message notifications to per-instance delivery queues. It is a logical service, not a specialized object type.

objects.name: Instance A delivery queue
objects.description: Buffers deliveries for connections currently served by instance A.

objects.name: Instance B delivery queue
objects.description: Buffers deliveries for connections currently served by instance B.

objects.name: Offline notification worker
objects.description: Decides whether disconnected recipients need an e-mail notification.

objects.name: Notification e-mail
objects.description: Sends offline summaries and account notifications.
